title: Fully offline verification
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL; QR Code Generation, 12.1 Scenario. QR Code Generation, 2.2 Choosing between a DVC and a VHL: “Works fully offline — Yes — verifier needs only the trust list”.

statements.label: Fully offline verification
statements.requirement: Given a cached or static trust list, verification SHALL need no network access.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-VER-009 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-VER-008 STT-VER-009 every failure is a value naming its step and reason, offline` (VerifyTest.kt); `STT-GEN-012 STT-VHL-010 STT-VER-009 the core does no network, file or asynchronous I-O` (ArchitectureTest.kt)).
